notes: Each entry names a guard in a natural-language function's instructions (edits[].find, an exact substring of the .nl body) and the refined slot of applications/<app>/DECOMPOSITION.md that states the same property as a type. scripts/refine_data generates the before/after pair from the repository; an entry whose find text, slot or field is missing is reported as an omission, never skipped silently. `replace` keeps the sentence the guard sat in readable once the property has moved into the type. `rev` entries read the function from git history, where the guard sentence was later removed by the application's rebuild.
